cardPayment.title: Card payment isn’t available here
cardPayment.body: This order was placed as a card payment, but we can’t take the card online yet. Please pay the restaurant directly — they can take it when you collect your order or when it arrives. Your order is not cancelled.
cardPayment.devNote: Development build only: mark the order paid so the rest of the flow can be tested.

transfer.confirmedBody: The restaurant has checked your slip and started your order.
transfer.rejectedTitle: Your transfer slip was not accepted

transfer.reviewBody: Have a look at the photo below. Replace it if it is not right, then confirm you have paid — that is what sends it to the restaurant.

transfer.confirmPaid: I’ve paid — send to the restaurant

errors.tooLarge: That image is larger than 10 MB.
errors.uploadFailed: The photo did not upload. Check your connection and try again.
errors.notYourOrder: We couldn’t find this transfer on your account. Sign in with the account you ordered with.
errors.slipRequired: Upload a photo of your transfer before confirming.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

actions.cancelPrompt: Changed your mind? Nothing has been prepared yet — the restaurant has not confirmed your transfer, so you can still call this order off.
actions.contactToChange: Need to change or cancel this order? Please contact the restaurant directly — they can update it for you while it’s still being prepared.

cancelErrors.signIn: Please sign in with the account you ordered with to cancel this order.
cancelErrors.otherAccount: This order belongs to a different account. Please contact the restaurant to cancel it.
cancelErrors.tooLate: This order has moved on and can no longer be cancelled here — please contact the restaurant.
cancelErrors.generic: That didn’t go through. Please try again, or contact the restaurant.

rating.thanksBody: Your feedback helps the restaurant get even better.
rating.driverFirst: Rate your rider first — the restaurant is next.
rating.driverOnly: Rate the rider who brought your order.
rating.foodLast: Last step — how was the food itself?
rating.foodOnly: Rate the food to finish up.

rating.foodPlaceholder: Anything to say about the food? (optional)

errors.signIn: Please sign in with the account you ordered with to rate this order.

issue.sent: Thanks — the restaurant has been notified.
issue.sendFailed: Couldn’t send your report. Please try again.
